_about: Source registry (task 149). Every dataset the site uses: licence, how a new version is detected, which workflow fetches it, and backup addresses of the SAME file. A backup is added only after a hand check that it serves the identical dataset; a different dataset is never switched in automatically (new licence, different definitions) — that is a new source, checked and approved by the owner first. scripts/tools/check-sources.mjs reads this file; .github/workflows/watch-sources.yml runs it every week.
